locator: p. 336 §I n.3, read with premises (1) and (2)
interpretation: The suggested qualification in p.336 n.3: one perhaps should not fault the being when preventing the suffering while losing the relevant good would not alter the balance. Records that proposed refined constraint, not a settled theorem about morally permissible permission and not the stronger simplified wording. Counterfactual necessity and the other qualifications of premises (1)/(2) are retained.
